notes.title: Pinecone Game: Albion
notes.notes:
So, you are probably wondering what Albion is mentioned at the end of the final update of Pinecone Game.

It's time to lift the veil of secrecy and announce that the development of a sequel to Pinecone Game called Pinecone Game: Albion has been underway for some time.

During the work on Pinecone Game, many different ideas that are already difficult to fit into the original game were born, and therefore it was decided to make a sequel.

The essence of the game will still be to collect pinecones and throw them into a well, but the process of finding pinecones will become more difficult and interesting. The game world will be divided into regions, in each of which the player will have to go through a separate adventure full of secrets and challenges.

In addition to the single-player campaign, there are also plans to add two multiplayer modes to the game:
[list]
[*] "Seeker's Lair" - will allow the player to become the owner of their own flying island, which can be furnished with relics found in adventures to the envy of friends and enemies.
[*] "Expedition" - will allow you to go to the most hidden and unstable corners of the world and explore them in search of pinecones together with several other Seekers.
[/list]
It is planned to release the game in early access. Regions for the single-player campaign will be added gradually, at the start of the game at least two regions will be available [spoiler](as well as one or more secret ones)[/spoiler]. Initially, the game will be released for PC on Steam, but in the future there is a possibility of porting it to other devices and platforms.

At the moment, Pinecone Game: Albion is in the process of developing the architecture and game mechanics of the single-player campaign.

The original Pinecone Game will continue to work. There will be no more content updates, but we will continue to release patches if any bugs are found.

Also, players who have achieved certain success in the Pinecone Game will receive various bonuses in Albion, so stay tuned and keep throwing pinecones into the well.

notes.title: Windows 11 initialisation bug fix
notes.notes:
In the Windows 11 operating system, an error could occur when starting the game, which led to incorrect initialization of the game, as a result of which the game subsystems began to work incorrectly. This error occurred when the game clearing old log files if the Documents folder was located in OneDrive, due to the fact that the game did not have enough rights to delete files and folders in this location.

To fix this error, it was decided to move the folder for recording and storing logs from *\Documents\Frameblade\Pinecone Game\Logs to %LocalAppData%\Frameblade\Pinecone Game\Logs

The old folder for storing logs will no longer be used and can be deleted manually if the game cannot do this automatically.

Discussion about this error: https://steamcommunity.com/app/1818150/discussions/0/600766842748866527/

notes.title: DDoS-attack is over
notes.notes:
For the past few days our servers have been under DDoS attack , causing many players had problems playing Pinecone Game. We are happy to report that we appear to have survived this attack and all game features are now working properly.

We apologize to our players, as compensation for the inconvenience caused, everyone was awarded 30 Pinecoins and 4 bonus Pinecones (the score in the leaderboard will be updated the next time the pinecone will be thrown into the well).

If you encounter any problems with the game, leave a message in one of the appropriate topics in the discussions, all requests will be considered.

[spoiler]The hacker who attacked us, if you are reading this, then please don’t do it anymore, it was fun, but we had enough [/spoiler]

notes.title: Frameblade Manifesto
notes.notes:
From this day on, our games belong to the players.

The Frameblade team works primarily to bring their ideas to life and give players a new and interesting experience, so now you can play all of our existing and future projects absolutely free.

For those who would like to support our team, we have added a paid DLC called "Supporter Pack" to each game. No, it does not give its owner any advantages, but simply adds a thank you message to the game.

Everyone who bought/received our games before today will receive Supporter Packs for the corresponding games automatically.
